conviction_note: A Q1 print that this name has twice treated as noise (+0.39% on 2024-10-11, -1.14% on 2025-10-14, real release dates). Tama Home has never revised its forecast at a Q1 print from 2022 to 2026 and pays no interim dividend. What is new in the release is a Q1 loss that will probably narrow from a record-low base, though perhaps not to the -2.15bn ordinary consensus, plus September orders against an easy 73% custom comp. These roughly offset, so p_up is 52 on abs_move 2.0, giving +0.08. The impact_sum of +0.2 agrees in sign and is small for the same reason.
bar: Q1 (Jun-Aug 2026) ordinary profit consensus -2,150m yen, FY ordinary consensus 6,520m against a company plan of 6,700m (kabuyoho, as of 2026-10-09: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=1419 and https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=1419). It comes from one source with a thin analyst count, and the Q1 split is not confirmed by a second source, so every size is capped small. print_vs_bar is my inference of a Q1 ordinary loss near -2.8bn, a loss about 30% larger than the bar. It is low confidence.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin ratio 0.29 per the baseline and kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=1419), so margin shorts exceed margin longs. The 株主優待 record month is November (last cum date 2026-11-26, https://kabutan.jp/stock/yutai?code=1419), so part of that short book is probably hedged 優待 cross positions and not squeeze fuel. There is no option skew in Japan. Run-up is -2.26% over 20 days and -1.92% over 5. The stock is 2,809 yen against 3,115 before the July print, with a 4.6% yield on the 130-yen plan.

findings.finding: The Q1 bar asks for the ordinary loss to roughly halve, from -4,439m to a -2,150m consensus. Last year's Q1 had only 556 custom-home deliveries (-39.4%), but the custom orders that feed Q1 FY27 deliveries were roughly flat on that weak base (Dec 2025-Apr 2026 custom 91/93/90/110/108% YoY). Detached-housing (分譲) orders ran +32-48% in Jun-Aug and real estate for sale in process doubled to 20.2bn, so the loss probably narrows YoY ('赤字縮小' headline) but probably falls short of the consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 prints moved +0.39% on 2024-10-11 (OP swung to -3,763m) and -1.14% on 2025-10-14 (loss widened to -4,435m, sales -20.8%). Measured off Yahoo daily closes on the real release dates; this name looks through the Q1 loss.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus has not moved in four weeks (6,520 FY ordinary unchanged across 1 and 4 weeks on kabuyoho), so nobody has re-marked the Q1 split against the monthly orders. If the market already doubted the -2.15bn bar, the stock would not be holding flat at -2% over 20 days. Against that, the monthly orders are public, so this is partly priced, and the size is small.
findings.independence: Monthly orders: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260611/140120260611567816.pdf (FY26 table) and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260910/140120260910534062.pdf (Jun-Aug 2026). The consensus split comes from https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=1419. These are separate documents, but the conclusion is my inference across them.

findings.finding: The September 2026 受注速報 will very likely come out in the same 15:30 batch, since the Sep-2025 orders were released with Q1 on 2025-10-14 and Jun-2026 with the FY print on 2026-07-14. It faces the easiest comp of the year (Sep 2025: custom 73%, total 78%), so a double-digit headline YoY rise is plausible. The two-year stack is fading, though: custom Jun 106%, Jul 90%, Aug 80%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Orders ship alongside every quarterly print, so their effect cannot be separated from the earnings reaction. Q1 FY26 printed custom orders -1.5% (Sep 2025 at 73%) and the stock moved -1.14%.
findings.why_not_priced: The comp is public, but the September number is not. A strong headline growth number tends to set the kabutan/Nikkei headline on the print day, and the stock sits near its lows with a -2% 20-day run-up rather than having rallied into an expected good number.
findings.independence: Comp base: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260611/140120260611567816.pdf (Sep 2025 custom 73%). Release-pattern evidence: the kabutan disclosure list https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1419&nmode=3&page=5 (Sep-2025 orders at 15:30 on 2025-10-14).

findings.finding: A forecast revision at this print is unlikely. Kabutan's revision log shows no Q1-print revision in 2022-2026; every revision came in January (H1), April (Q3), June or July (pre-FY). The street (6,520 FY ordinary) already sits below the company's 6,700, so holding the plan disappoints nobody.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revision prints moved +2.56% on 2026-01-13 (a downward revision read as 悪材料出尽くし), -9.98% on 2026-04-10 (dividend cut 195 to 125 yen) and -9.32% on 2025-01-14 (downward revision).
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing unpriced here. It sets the scale: without a revision this print should sit at the Q1-history scale (about 1%), not the 5.28% all-print proxy.
findings.independence: The FY27 guide and the 130-yen dividend plan come from the FY2026 tanshin (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714592857.pdf); the IFIS FY27 ordinary consensus was 7,290 before the guide (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/1419_20260714_act_20260714_153033_2) and 6,520 now (kabuyoho).

findings.finding: The low margin ratio (0.29) sits ahead of a November 優待 record date (QUO card, last cum date 2026-11-26), so the margin short book is probably partly hedged 優待 crosses and not squeeze fuel. The baseline's +0.27 margin_overhang lean is likely overstated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no record of this name squeezing on a print.
findings.why_not_priced: This is not an unpriced fact. It corrects how the baseline's lean should be read.
findings.independence: The JPX disclosed register shows 0.0% (baseline), so there is no institutional short above 0.5% either.

findings.finding: A 12bn yen syndicated term loan (SMBC arranger, drawn 2026-08-28, maturing 2029) for general purposes, with covenants that include non-negative consolidated OP for FY27. It funds the 分譲 land build-up, which is corroborated by real estate for sale in process rising from 10.3bn to 20.2bn and by 分譲 orders running +38% in Q1. It is not distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measured. The 2026-05-29 early repayment of the prior syndicated loan was a non-event.
findings.why_not_priced: It was disclosed in August and is priced. The Q1 balance sheet will show the debt, but the money buys 分譲 inventory that the order data says is selling.
findings.independence: Balance sheet in the FY2026 supplementary material (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593215.pdf): real estate for sale in process 20,183m against 10,290m.

outside_window.finding: The FY27 plan (sales +16.3%, OP 7.5bn) rests on a custom-home recovery that orders do not yet show (custom 98% YoY cumulative Jun-Aug). The company missed even its January-revised FY26 plan (OP 3.8bn against 4.7bn), and its revisions have historically come at the January H1 print.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +0.38 (mostly margin_overhang plus run-up) and my evidence is roughly neutral to slightly positive, so it does not cut against the lean; but the margin-overhang component is probably 優待 cross and overstates squeeze fuel. The strongest positive the release could carry is a strong September order headline on an easy comp plus a narrowed Q1 loss with the plan and the 130-yen dividend held (悪材料出尽くし at a 4.6% yield near the lows). I looked for both; neither is decisive.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public monthly series): the Q1-vs-consensus finding rests on public 受注速報 data, so I cut it from -0.2 to -0.1. p_up was already at 52 and not moved further.

Rule 2 (sign check): I wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension and confirmed I had looked for it. With one small negative against one positive the set is not tilted negative, so nothing else changed.
